"''I should stop thinking about him.|Cassian Andor, to Bix Caleen|}} A [[human]] [[gender|male]] '''soldier''' worked for the [[Galactic Empire]] was [[death|killed]] by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] during a [[Unidentified mission (Andor and Caleen)|mission]] in [[3 BBY]] in order to protect [[Bix Caleen]] after the soldier saw their faces. Caleen struggled with the killing of the soldier, even including them in a nightmare she had where the soldier was tortured to death by [[doctor]] [[Gorst]]. In the nightmare, the soldier had dark [[hair]], tan skin, blue [[eye]]s. She later questioned Andor about it while he prepared food at their [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse]] stating that she could not stop seeing the soldier's face. Andor defending the killing stating that they were in a war and that he was a threat and he choose to put on the uniform. ==Behind the scenes== The soldier appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fourth episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} {{C|Appears in dream}} ==Sources== *{{CelebrationTrailer|[[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' Season 2]]|Celebration Europe (2023)}} {{1stp}} {{C|In dream}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი ჯარისკაცი (ბიქს კალინი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army troopers]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
